verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site states it directly: users can email or upload receipts and Mercury auto-attaches them to the right card transaction. The API also offers a transaction-attachment upload endpoint and an official receipt-upload agent skill. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the email-forwarding setup and how matching works, independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-matching is accurate, and confirmation that it covers non-card transactions.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have receipts automatically attached to the right transaction by emailing or uploading them
